nodes.klein: to straighten. he covered with lead. he straightened, made straight (orig.: made the wall straight by means of a plummet). he drew a perpendicular line. was straightened; was made straight. was made perpendicular. was covered with lead. was soldered.

nodes.g: to be right, be straight, be level, be upright, be just, be lawful, be smooth
to be soft, be delicate, be dainty
to serve as a necklace, adorn with a neck ornament
